findings.title: Main and collector release verification does not reject unmanifested candidate drift
findings.trigger: Extra source file added to prepared Main candidate after PLAN creation
findings.evidence: Independent isolated fixture: prepared candidate, added unmanifested_module.py only to candidate Main, operator.stage(plan) and operator.verify_release(plan,'main') both succeeded. MAIN_UNMANIFESTED_EXTRA_STAGED_AND_VERIFY_RELEASE_PASSED True; EXTRA_INCLUDED_IN_MANIFEST False.
findings.cause: Reused stage copies whole candidate while verify_release only checks enumerated app_files/symlinks; no complete-inventory Main/collector guard.
findings.impact: Unreviewed files can enter staged release and change import behavior despite reported integrity success.
findings.minimum_fix: Compare complete candidate inventory to frozen manifest before staging and complete staged inventory before service actions and successful readback; Main, collector, API covered.
findings.focused_regression: Post-prepare extra-file drift and staged-tree extra-file drift must reject before service actions.

findings.title: Retained business PASS receipt is rejected by preparation contract

findings.impact: Preparation rejects unchanged valid independent business PASS; synthetic top-level PASS fixture missed actual format.
findings.minimum_fix: Recognize exact retained receipt schema/REVIEWED/PASS and bind frozen-source/overlay hashes, or explicit adapter bound to original SHA.
findings.focused_regression: Real receipt shape accepted, non-PASS and mismatched freeze rejected.

findings.focused_regression: Missing/inconsistent domain rejected; actual helper parameter contract covered.
